official.application_cycle: Continuous intake; applications must be submitted at least one year before the expected starting date of the stay
official.status_note: The programme runs continuously; the official page directs applicants to submit through the electronic services at zamalat.arabfund.org at least one year prior to the expected start of the stay at the foreign university
benefits: Full financial support: a fixed maintenance allowance so the fellow can focus entirely on academic activity
Round-trip airfare tickets for the beneficiary and the eligible members of their family
Health and personal accident insurance for the duration of the stay
eligibility: Previous beneficiaries of the Fellowship are not eligible to re-apply
Intended activity is advanced research and/or academic activity at a foreign university
requirements: Hold a PhD and be an Arab national
Secure placement at a foreign university to conduct advanced research and/or teach
Submit the application at least one year before the expected start date of the stay
selection_criteria: Excellent academic track record in different fields of specialization
Arab scholars seeking to lecture or conduct advanced research at world-renowned universities
coverage: Round-trip airfare for the beneficiary and eligible family members
Health and personal accident insurance for the duration of the stay
application_method: Register and submit the application through the Arab Fund's electronic services portal for the fellowship service (zamalat.arabfund.org)
Submit at least one year before the intended start of the stay at the host university
official.application_route: Apply through the Arab Fund's electronic fellowship service at zamalat.arabfund.org, at least one year before the expected start of the stay
official.international_eligibility: For Arab nationals; the research or teaching stay takes place at a foreign university
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Advanced research and/or teaching at a foreign university; not a degree-enrolment award
official.research_requirement: Advanced research and/or academic activity at a foreign university, building bridges between Arab and foreign academic institutions
official.duration: Usually 12 months; shorter periods are considered only in very special cases
official.description: Since 1997 the Arab Fund's Fellowship Program has empowered Arab scholars with excellent academic track records to conduct advanced research and/or academic activity at prestigious universities, building bridges between Arab and foreign academic institutions; about 191 scholarships have been awarded since inception.

applicant_utility.summary: This is a senior mobility fellowship, not a study scholarship: you must already hold a PhD and have a foreign host placement to lecture or conduct advanced research abroad. There is no deadline to chase because intake is continuous, but the one-year lead rule means the host university and project must be agreed roughly 12 months before you want to start. Previous fellows cannot re-apply, and the maintenance allowance is fixed but unpublished, so budget planning requires asking the Fund directly.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Arab PhD holders in academia or research who already have, or can quickly secure, a visiting research or teaching placement at a foreign university.
application_readiness_checklist: Line up a host department and an agreed research or teaching plan before applying
Apply through zamalat.arabfund.org at least one year before the intended start
Confirm you are not a previous beneficiary of the Fellowship
Ask the Secretariat what the current fixed maintenance allowance covers for your family situation
common_rejection_risks: Applying less than a year before the intended start date
No confirmed foreign host placement - the fellowship funds an activity at a foreign university
Family airfare expectations beyond 'eligible members' - dependant eligibility is decided case by case
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The page publishes a fixed maintenance allowance, round-trip airfare and insurance but not their values; tuition or enrolment fees at the host are not mentioned, so host-institution charges would be self-funded unless the Fund confirms otherwise.
document_audit: Applications go through the zamalat electronic services portal - it is the stated route
Evidence of the PhD and Arab nationality will be needed even though the page does not itemise a checklist
The host university's agreement matters as much as the Fund's form
alerts: Apply at least one year before the expected start of the stay - the only timing rule published
Previous beneficiaries are barred from re-applying
Duration is normally 12 months; shorter stays only in very special cases, so plan a realistic project
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Register and submit through the Arab Fund's electronic fellowship service at zamalat.arabfund.org, timed at least one year before the intended start of the stay.
